{{Quote|When Master Wena put us up for auction, I had hoped a senator from Alderaan would purchase us, or perhaps a merchant from the Core systems&hellip; but to be sold ''sight unseen'' to a junk trader, and shipped off to the ''Kalarba system''&mdash;how humiliating!|C-3PO, to R2-D2|<ref name="Droids Special" />}}
A '''junk trader''' from the [[Kalarba system/Legends|Kalarba system]] purchased the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]<ref name="EGTC Droids" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[6 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]].<ref name="Omnibus Droids">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Droids]]'' {{C|introduction to [[Star Wars: Droids (1994)|''The Kalarba Adventures'']]}}</ref> The droids had previously belonged to the Kalarba [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wena Havid]], who flitted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in a luxurious [[Starship/Legends|starship]], but when the governor was bankrupted, most of his possessions were placed on the auction block. The [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk trader]] bought C-3PO and R2-D2 at rock-bottom prices, and the droids were subsequently placed on a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] bound for the Kalarba system.<ref name="Golden Droid">''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]''</ref>

The freighter also contained a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] shipment belonging to the crooked businessman [[Olag Greck]], as well as the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]<ref name="Droids Special">''[[Star Wars: Droids Special]]''</ref> [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88B]].<ref name="NEGTC IG-88">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' {{C|under "IG-88"}}</ref> When the freighter landed at the system's [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]], both C-3PO and R2-D2 became mixed up in an encounter between Greck and the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] droid. The misadventure concluded with the two [[Counterpart/Legends|counterparts]] taking an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to the surface of [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]], where they were taken in by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pitareeze family]], whom they accepted as their new masters.<ref name="Droids Special" />
